band_power: Sum Welch PSD bins per epoch/channel divided by total 1-45 Hz power
theta_alpha_ratio: Aggregated theta divided by aggregated alpha
artifact_rules: Exclude 2-second epoch if >=3 channels ptp>200uV, any channel ptp>300uV, or any channel std<0.5uV
note: Separate duration protocol; not claimed identical to prior 300-second baseline
